text:
nina: quick FYI 9 PR #4688 modifies the error-ref examples for 429/timeouts. editorial pass is good but one Python snippet is using `timeout_ms` (old helper) and fails runtime.
josh: which file? link?
nina: under docs/error-ref/ratelimits.md 9 the 'client-side timeouts' code block. here9s what was committed:
```py
# from PR #4688
resp = client.generate(
    model='rwd-2b',
    prompt='Explain event loop',
    timeout_ms=1500,
)
```
sara: ah, yep 9 we deprecated `timeout_ms` in favor of `timeout` (seconds) and the SDK linter rejects it.
lee: i can push a 1-line replacement to the PR: `timeout=1.5`. also add a short note about semantic difference: client deadline vs server-enforced timelimit.
josh: while you're editing, can we also show how the server might respond with a 429 and `Retry-After` in seconds? folks copy-paste examples and miss normalization.
lee: good call. propose a tiny handling snippet that normalizes both headers (pseudo code). keeps language-agnostic and short.
dev-bot: PR #4688 status: changes requested -> lee (requested by sara).
sara: add a tiny pseudo backoff example (3 lines) with jitter; keep it pseudocode so we don't ship multiple language variants.
nina: and a one-sentence callout for Dedicated customers: "If you have Dedicated capacity, consider pinning model versions or configuring a lower concurrency to reduce 429s."
ja: small QA ask: can we add a docs smoke test that asserts the example runs (lint + sample response) and that the Retry-After normalization line is present? qa-bot can pick this up.
qa-bot: noted 9 raising ticket DOCDIFF-77 to add a smoke test harness under docs/tests/429-regress.
josh: also double-check we aren't duplicating the backoff pseudo-code from 1799990001; if similar, reword to be a minimal single-line jitter suggestion and link to the err-ref.
lee: will do. i9ll push the snippet change, the timeout rename, and a one-line `retry_after = resp.get('retry_after_ms') or (resp.get('retry_after') * 1000 if resp.get('retry_after') else None)` example for python users.
sara: editorial will tighten "time limit" vs "timeout" language as a 2-liner above the snippet.
nina: timeline: if lee can open a small follow-up PR today we can get this merged before the larger merge later this week. please ping here when it's up.
lee: opening PR #4688.1 with fixes now. will request review from sara + nina.
dev-bot: PR #4688.1 created by lee -> reviewers: sara, nina.
qa-bot: DOCDIFF-77 created -> assigned to qa-team.
josh: thanks all. once merged i'll trigger a quick link-checker sweep to ensure the err-ref anchors are valid.
sara: thanks 9 i9ll do editorial pass and confirm the mini-table for terms.
nina: appreciate it. :thumbsup:
